description: Return Tineo's travel-affiliate catalog with truthful implementation status. Use only for questions about supported affiliate programs, never for a link to a specific or previously searched travel result. With generic search intent, validated generic adapters may include safe Tineo-owned CTA links. A card with bookingLink=null is metadata only, not a booking handoff or live inventory.

currency.description: Optional ISO-style three-letter display currency. Omit to use the user's preferred currency, then the currency of the trip given by trip_id, then USD.

endDate.description: Optional local end/check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

includeResearch.description: Include catalogued/research programs. Defaults to true.

location.description: Optional city or destination used to build the provider search.

searchTerm.description: Concrete search intent. Required to generate booking CTA buttons.

startDate.description: Optional local start/check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

trip_id.description: Optional Tineo trip ID (from trips_list) this request is for. Used only to default the currency to that trip's currency when currency is omitted and the user has no preferred currency; ignored if the trip is not found or not accessible to the user.

vertical.description: Optional category filter, such as Hotels, Tours, Flights, Trains, or Transfers.

name: affiliate_program_catalog
title: Affiliate Program Catalog
